retrievalProfile.description: A surrealist collage featuring a central portrait surrounded by floating celestial bodies and glowing blue clouds against a vibrant red-to-black gradient space background.
triggerTerms: surreal space portrait with glowing clouds

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition blending a human subject with cosmic elements like disco-ball planets and bioluminescent clouds, characterized by high-contrast lighting and a saturated red and blue color palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Central human figure anchored by large foreground clouds
Floating disco-ball spheres creating a sense of depth in the upper left
Vibrant red sky transitioning into a dark, starry void
Repetitive typographic elements scattered across different depth planes
coreInvariants: Bioluminescent blue clouds in the foreground
High-contrast red and black space background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central human figure, medium shot, slightly tilted, occupying the middle ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: Large, glowing blue cloud in the bottom center foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central face, moves upward to the disco-ball planets, then spirals down through the scattered text to the large foreground cloud.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark space between the clouds and planets provides breathing room for the scattered text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red and black space background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Electric blue for the glowing clouds.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and white for the scattered text and highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and blues against deep black shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high contrast between red and blue

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Repetition of a single typeface at varying scales, colors, and angles to create rhythm.
graphicDevices: Color-coded text based on background contrast

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the humanist sans-serif feel and lowercase charm.
Provides a geometric alternative that fits the space theme.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal space scene with a red-to-black gradient sky, floating disco-ball planets in the upper left, and large, glowing electric-blue clouds in the foreground. Place a central portrait of a person with glasses in the middle ground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lowercase sans-serif text in various sizes and colors (yellow, red, white). Angle the main title in the top right on a yellow strip. Scatter smaller instances of text at different angles across the composition.

verificationChecks: Is the background a red-to-black gradient?
Are the clouds glowing electric blue?
Is the text primarily lowercase sans-serif?
Are there disco-ball textured spheres present?

mustRedesign: Avoid literal transcription of original band names
Do not use exact celebrity likenesses
postGenerationChecks: Check for glowing blue cloud effect
Ensure text is scattered and angled
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central portrait with cosmic elements (disco planets, glowing clouds) and scattered, angled lowercase sans-serif typography against a high-contrast red/black space gradient.
